answer: Each identity must publish one sonnet whose 14 lines each lock 1 opal, and the k-th identity from one operator must lock k sonnets, since each new sonnet must rhyme against all prior sonnets with no repeat. Fake k costs 14k opals: 10 pay 770, 100 pay 70,700. A fable with no bonded sonnet earns nothing; sonnets cannot be pooled, each line committing to one identity's opal alone.
